lines.en: label sportswars5:
scene mayaamisadroom1
: But her feelings are far more complicated than just “unwell.”
lines.zh: : 但她的心情，远不只是「不舒服」这么简单。

lines.en: : They are...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: : Suffocating...
lines.zh: : 令人窒息……

lines.en: For a week now, I’ve been wondering — what skills I need to fly.
lines.zh: 这一周来，我一直在想——要飞起来，究竟需要什么样的本领。

lines.en: If hope alone can grant me wings — if concern alone is fine.
lines.zh: 单凭希望能否为我生出一双翅膀——单凭牵挂是否就已足够。

lines.en: But the problem with this dream of mine’s not the chance that I may die-
lines.zh: 可我这个梦的症结，并不在于我可能会死——

lines.en: It’s the fact that I might hurt you.
lines.zh: 而在于我也许会伤到你。

lines.en: It’s the chance that you might cry.
lines.zh: 在于你也许会落泪的可能。

lines.en: Who raps upon my chamber door? Who crawls across these marble floors?
lines.zh: 是谁在敲我的房门？是谁爬过大理石的地板？

lines.en: Who scratches at my coffin’s lid and mocks the raven’s “nevermore?”
lines.zh: 是谁在抓挠我的棺盖，嘲笑乌鸦口中的「永不复焉」？

lines.en: I hear things, Boy. I’m scared. I’m yours!
lines.zh: 我听见了声响，小子。我很害怕。我是你的！

lines.en: But you're not here when I need you.
lines.zh: 可我需要你的时候，你却不在。

lines.en: There's no glow to make me pure.
lines.zh: 没有那道让我变得纯净的光。

lines.en: They’re here again. I hear them. Those endless, violent knocks-
lines.zh: 它们又来了。我听见了。那无休无止、暴烈的敲击——

lines.en: It’s been three weeks since I’ve slept, I think — this dead bird never mocks.
lines.zh: 我想，我已经三周没有睡过了——这只死鸟从不嘲笑。

lines.en: But the blues and reds still fly, I think. I think the door’s unlocked.
lines.zh: 可蓝与红依然在飞，我想。我想那扇门没有上锁。

lines.en: I think I think I’m losing it. I think I think I’m lost.
lines.zh: 我想我想我快疯了。我想我想我迷路了。

lines.en: Arakiel’s silhouette — Azrael’s old cot>
lines.zh: Arakiel 的剪影——Azrael 的旧床>

lines.en: Daniel’s misbegotten snake — Etinsib Ziwa’s war/Nbat!
lines.zh: Daniel 那条不该存在的蛇——Etinsib Ziwa 的战争/Nbat！

lines.en: Harmozel and Hofniel* What Gossamer forgot}
lines.zh: Harmozel 与 Hofniel* 是 Gossamer 遗忘的东西}

lines.en: I think my light is burning out.
lines.zh: 我想我的光就要燃尽了。

lines.en: I fear my mind will rot.
lines.zh: 我怕我的心会腐烂。

lines.en: : Ami?...Are you in there?
lines.zh: : Ami？……你在里面吗？

lines.en: : I’m coming in, okay?
lines.zh: : 我进来了，可以吗？

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom2
Maya Makinami entered the room.
lines.zh: Maya Makinami 走进了房间。

lines.en: It was the first time in months she’d done that. And she immediately noticed the complete absence of strawberry — an aroma she’d come to associate almost exclusively with the pinks and reds these walls held.
lines.zh: 这是几个月来她第一次这么做。她立刻察觉到，草莓的气味彻底消失了——那种她几乎只会拿来和这四壁间的粉与红联系在一起的香气。

lines.en: She glanced down at a bed she’d fallen asleep in time and time again, but what she saw there was unlike anything she’d ever seen on any of those fun-filled, sugary nights.
lines.zh: 她低头看向那张自己曾经一次次睡过的床，可眼前所见，与那些充满欢乐、甜腻的夜晚里见过的任何东西都不同。

lines.en: It was a body acting more like a statue — completely unmoving. And there was a moment where she feared her friend might have actually died and was just being hidden here.
lines.zh: 那是一具更像雕塑的身体——纹丝不动。有一瞬间，她甚至害怕她的朋友是真的死了，只是被藏在了这里。

lines.en: Her life thus far was complicated, that much was certain. But not complicated to the point where stumbling across a corpse wouldn’t be the worst thing that ever happened to her.
lines.zh: 迄今为止她的人生很复杂，这一点毫无疑问。但再怎么复杂，撞见一具尸体也依然是她这辈子最糟的事。

lines.en: Regardless, that was something she did not want to encounter today. For she loved the statue on the bed. She loved how it was more fragile than other notable statues.
lines.zh: 无论如何，她今天不想碰上这种事。因为她爱床上那座雕塑。她爱它比其他著名的雕塑更脆弱这一点。

lines.en: It was much more frail than David, possessing a level of beauty somewhere between Rodina-Mat' Zovyot! and Venus de Milo- but she felt the urge to act as an engineer rather than a critic right now.
lines.zh: 它比大卫像脆弱得多，拥有的美介于《Rodina-Mat' Zovyot!》与《米洛的维纳斯》之间——但此刻她更想当一个工程师，而不是一个评论家。

lines.en: She observed the contours of the sculpture’s body. Let them soak into her mind and overwrite the recently-decayed image of them, now inaccurate in a multitude of ways.
lines.zh: 她注视着那座雕塑身体的轮廓。让它们渗入脑海，覆盖掉那幅最近已经腐坏、在诸多方面都不再准确的影像。

lines.en: She’d lost weight. Lost hair. Lost sanity. Lost faith. Lost everything because that’s what happens when you spend too long in the dark.
lines.zh: 她瘦了。掉了头发。失去了理智。失去了信仰。失去了一切——因为在黑暗里待得太久，就会变成这样。

lines.en: But the dark is precisely where some people should be.
lines.zh: 可黑暗恰恰是有些人该待的地方。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom3
The dark is rather beautiful, you see.
lines.zh: 你瞧，黑暗其实相当美。

lines.en: And yes, it might take the untrained eye several minutes to become fully acclimated, but it promises a world unlike any other once you see what you’re meant to.
lines.zh: 没错，未经训练的眼睛也许要花上几分钟才能完全适应，可一旦你看见了注定要看见的东西，它就会向你许诺一个与众不同的世界。

lines.en: Do you see what you’re meant to?
lines.zh: 你看见你注定要看见的东西了吗？

lines.en: Maya Makinami sees what she’s meant to.
lines.zh: Maya Makinami 看见了她注定要看见的东西。

lines.en: She thinks of a way to repair the sculpture. How to restore it to its former beauty — and it was a beauty she was often entranced by, so she wanted to do that as soon as possible.
lines.zh: 她想着该如何修复这座雕塑。该如何让它恢复往日的光彩——那是一种常常令她着迷的美，所以她想尽快动手。

lines.en: For, you see, there was one creature taking up the majority of her mind. There was one creature she preferred seeing over the others. But that didn’t mean her mind didn’t occasionally wander.
lines.zh: 因为，你瞧，有那么一个生物占据了她大部分的思绪。有那么一个生物，比起其他人她更愿意见到。但这不代表她的思绪不会偶尔开小差。

lines.en: She’s a human after all. She’s not perfect by any means. She’s not pure by any means. But she knows how to return love to those she ranks the highest.
lines.zh: 她毕竟只是个人类。她绝不完美。她也绝不纯洁。但她知道该怎样把爱还给那些在她心中排位最高的人。

lines.en: And Ami Arakawa would always be her number two — regardless of who or what would have her rethink that.
lines.zh: 而 Ami Arakawa 永远是她的第二位——无论有谁、有什么会让她重新考虑这一点。

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : Are you awake?...
lines.zh: : 你醒着吗？……

lines.en: The two of them were alone in this house.
lines.zh: 这栋屋子里只有她们两个人。

lines.en: Regardless of who or what would have you rethink that.
lines.zh: 无论有谁、有什么会让你重新考虑这一点。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : You sound awake.
lines.zh: : 你听着像是醒的。

lines.en: : I’m not awake.
lines.zh: : 我没醒。

lines.en: : Are you thirsty?
lines.zh: : 你渴吗？

lines.en: : Hungry?
lines.zh: : 饿吗？

lines.en: : Do you want me to leave you alone?
lines.zh: : 你想让我别烦你吗？

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom4
: We’re having the Dorm Wars today. Well...they’re having the Dorm Wars today.
lines.zh: : 今天要办宿舍大战。嗯……是她们今天要办宿舍大战。

lines.en: : I’m supposed to be there too, but...
lines.zh: : 我也该在那儿的，可是……

lines.en: : You should go...I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 你该去……我没事。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom5
: You don’t look fine. You look sick.
lines.zh: : 你看着不像没事。你看着像病了。

lines.en: : I am sick. Contagious too. So it would probably be best if you left or you’ll wind up catching it as well.
lines.zh: : 我是病了。还传染。所以你最好还是走吧，不然你也会被传染的。

lines.en: : Is it deadly?
lines.zh: : 会致死吗？

lines.en: : Very.
lines.zh: : 非常致命。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom6
: Oh well. At least we’ll die together.
lines.zh: : 那好吧。至少我们会死在一起。

lines.en: : Any idea how much longer you’ll be staying here? Should I be preparing for a life without you? Because, with the way Ayane’s been acting lately, I could use a friend who isn’t completely insane.
lines.zh: : 你打算在这儿再待多久？我要不要准备好过没有你的人生？因为照 Ayane 最近的样子，我实在需要一个不是完全疯掉的朋友。

lines.en: : How...has Ayane been acting?
lines.zh: : Ayane……最近怎么了？

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom7
: God, where do I even begin?
lines.zh: : 天哪，该从哪儿说起呢？

lines.en: : She keeps saying all this stuff about how I’m acting differently and how my memories have been reset and I’m like, 99%% sure she’s going insane from a lack of Sensei.
lines.zh: : 她一直念叨说我变得不一样了、说我的记忆被重置了，而我大概有 99% 的把握——她是缺了 Sensei 才快疯了。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom8
: Huh...
: And I’m pretty sure Makoto is in on it too, which is super fucking weird because I didn’t even know the two of them talked to one another.
lines.zh: : 而且我敢肯定 Makoto 也掺和进来了，这他妈诡异得要命，因为我压根不知道她们俩会说上话。

lines.en: : Sounds like things have gotten pretty weird without me, huh?...
lines.zh: : 听起来，没有我的日子变得挺怪的，是吧？……

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom9
: I mean, yeah. But they were getting pretty weird with you too. Especially after that psychopathic rant you went on in the classroom about harvesting our organs or whatever.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。可有你在的时候也够怪的了。尤其是你在教室里发表那通关于收割我们器官之类的疯话之后。

lines.en: : Heheh...yeah. I guess that was pretty crazy in hindsight.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……是啊。现在回头看，那确实挺疯的。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom10
: I kinda meant it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我多少是真心的。

lines.en: : I’m tired of everyone using Sensei for their own personal gain. You understand, don’t you? You’d never do something like that, right?
lines.zh: : 我受够了所有人为了自己的利益利用 Sensei。你懂的吧？你绝不会做那种事，对吧？

lines.en: : Of course not.
lines.zh: : 当然不会。

lines.en: : So you support me?
lines.zh: : 那你是支持我的？

lines.en: : As in...do I think it’s okay for you to reproduce with your uncle?
lines.zh: : 你是问……我觉不觉得你和你舅舅繁衍后代是件好事？

lines.en: : More or less.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。

lines.en: : It is my personal belief that no one should reproduce with anyone because babies are a plague upon this land and should be purged from it entirely.
lines.zh: : 我个人认为，任何人都不该和任何人生孩子，因为婴儿是这片土地上的瘟疫，应该被彻底清除。

lines.en: : That sounds like a cop-out answer to me.
lines.zh: : 这听上去像是在敷衍我。

lines.en: : Yeah, well I find it hard to imagine me ever agreeing to the idea of a bunch of mini Senseis running around Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我实在想象不出自己会同意让一群迷你 Sensei 在 Kumon-mi 到处乱跑。

lines.en: : What about a bunch of little Amis?
lines.zh: : 那一群小 Ami 呢？

lines.en: : Better. Still chaotic, though. A bunch of mini Mayas on the other hand...
lines.zh: : 好一点。不过还是很混乱。至于一群迷你 Maya 嘛……

lines.en: : Are you saying you want my uncle to breed you too?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你也想让我舅舅来播种？

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom11
: What? No. I was just-
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。我只是——

lines.en: : I’m just kidding...
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的……

lines.en: : But, if we’re going to keep talking...would you mind coming a little closer? My voice is really weak right now...and having you so far away is making me sad.
lines.zh: : 不过，要是我们还想继续聊……你能不能靠近一点？我现在声音很虚弱……你离这么远，让我很难过。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom12
: Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: scene black
: I was just about to come over there anyway...
lines.zh: : 我本来也正要过去……

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom13
: So...what inspired the new haircut?
lines.zh: : 那么……是什么让你换了这个新发型？

lines.en: : Let’s just say I was having a really bad day.
lines.zh: : 只能说，那天我过得特别糟。

lines.en: : I kind of like it. It goes well with your new “I don’t mind killing my classmates if they talk to my uncle” attitude. Which, I guess isn’t totally new. But definitely more open than normal.
lines.zh: : 我还挺喜欢的。它和你那副「只要有人跟我舅舅说话，我不介意杀了同班同学」的新态度很配。虽然我想这也不算全新。但肯定比平时外露多了。

lines.en: : You’re a little more open than normal too.
lines.zh: : 你也比平时外露一点。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom14
: Am I? How?
lines.zh: : 是吗？怎么说？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe your memories really were reset after all and you just aren’t aware of it?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许你的记忆真的被重置了，只是你自己没察觉？

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom15
: Please don’t mess with me like that. I’ve already had to tell off two people today and I was hoping I’d somehow find salvation here.
lines.zh: : 别这样耍我。今天我已经把两个人骂回去了，本来还指望能在这儿找到点救赎。

lines.en: : But you never expected to find that salvation in me...right?
lines.zh: : 可你从没指望能在我身上找到那份救赎……对吧？

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom16
: Huh?
: You’re here for Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你是为 Sensei 来的……

lines.en: : That’s...not true. If I was here for Sensei, I wouldn’t have bothered-
lines.zh: : 那……不是真的。如果我为了 Sensei 来的，我就不会费心——

lines.en: : Yes you would have. You probably just want to see if I know where he is. Which, I’m sorry to break it to you...but I don’t.
lines.zh: : 你会的。你大概只是想看看我知不知道他在哪儿。很抱歉要让你失望……可我不知道。

lines.en: : Ami...I didn’t come all the way here just to-
lines.zh: : Ami……我大老远跑来，不是为了——

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom17
: Maya...it’s okay. You’re my best friend. If I’m going to lose to anyone, I’d prefer losing to you.
lines.zh: : Maya……没关系的。你是我最好的朋友。如果要输给谁，我宁愿输给你。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom18
: Where is this coming from? When have I ever expressed any amount of interest in your uncle? Where did you even get that idea?
lines.zh: : 你这话从哪儿来的？我什么时候对你舅舅表现出过哪怕一丁点兴趣？你到底是从哪儿得来这个念头的？

lines.en: : You’re so pretty, Maya.
lines.zh: : 你真漂亮，Maya。

lines.en: : Yeah, I know. But what do you have to gain from pointing that out now?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道。可你现在特意说出来，图什么呢？

lines.en: : Nothing in particular, I guess.
lines.zh: : 也没什么特别的目的吧。

lines.en: : I’ve just missed you.
lines.zh: : 我只是想你了。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom19
: I’ve missed you too. Which is why I’d really like for you to stop being insane and come back to school ASAP so I won’t feel like a fucking alien anymore.
lines.zh: : 我也想你。所以我很希望你别再疯了，赶紧回学校来，好让我不再觉得自己像个他妈的外星人。

lines.en: : I have bad news for you, Maya. I don’t think I’m ever going to stop being insane. And I really don’t think anyone from class is ever going to look at me the same again even if I do.
lines.zh: : 有个坏消息要告诉你，Maya。我觉得我这辈子都不会不疯了。而且我真的觉得，就算我不疯了，班上也不会有人再用同样的眼光看我了。

lines.en: : That’s not true. Like half of our class has some sort of mental illness. I’m sure they’d be more than willing to accept you again if you just apologize and...don’t steal their insides.
lines.zh: : 才不是呢。我们班大概一半的人都有某种精神疾病。只要你道个歉，再……别偷走她们的内脏，我敢肯定她们会很乐意重新接纳你的。

lines.en: : Why should I have to apologize for just being myself?
lines.zh: : 我只是做我自己，凭什么要道歉？

lines.en: : You don’t have to. But at least you can get people back on your side by faking it.
lines.zh: : 你不必道歉。但至少你可以靠装样子把大家拉回你这边。

lines.en: : You’re starting to sound like Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你说话开始像 Sensei 了。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom20
: Nah. If anything, he’s probably just ripping off my personality after realizing how much better than him I am.
lines.zh: : 才不是。要说的话，他大概是意识到我比他强太多了，才在模仿我的性格。

lines.en: : Watch it. I love you, but I’ll always love him more.
lines.zh: : 说话注意点。我爱你，但我永远更爱他。

lines.en: : You can love him more and still acknowledge that I’m a superior being. Don’t worry, I won’t tell.
lines.zh: : 你可以更爱他，同时承认我是更高级的生物。别担心，我不会说出去的。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom21
: You’re definitely softer...
lines.zh: : 你确实变柔软了……

lines.en: : Yeah?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : You smell nicer too...
lines.zh: : 你闻起来也更香了……

lines.en: : Please, continue. It’s really nice hearing compliments after being told for months that I’m broken.
lines.zh: : 请继续。在被说成「坏掉了」好几个月之后，能听到夸奖真的很舒服。

lines.en: : I could do this forever...
lines.zh: : 我可以一直这样下去……

lines.en: : You’d dare confine me to the same prison as you?
lines.zh: : 你竟敢把我关进和你同一座监狱？

lines.en: : I think you might like it here. We wouldn’t have to worry about anyone misunderstanding us anymore.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能会喜欢这儿。我们就不用再担心被人误解了。

lines.en: : But also....seeing nothing but each other might cloud our minds.
lines.zh: : 不过呢……眼里只有彼此，也许会让我们的心智蒙上阴影。

lines.en: : How so?
lines.zh: : 怎么说？

lines.en: : Who knows?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？

lines.en: : Maybe we’d fall in love?
lines.zh: : 也许我们会坠入爱河？

lines.en: : Maybe we already have?
lines.zh: : 也许我们早就坠入了？

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom22
: Bonk.
: Geh...is this really necessary?
lines.zh: : 呃……真有必要这样吗？

lines.en: : I will not let you convert me when I’m at my most vulnerable, you heathen.
lines.zh: : 我不会让你在我最脆弱的时候度化我的，你这异教徒。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom23
: But I will move over so you can lie with me...
lines.zh: : 但我会挪过去一点，好让你躺在我身边……

lines.en: scene black
: Just like old times...
lines.zh: : 就像从前一样……

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom24
: Even like this, you’re still the most adorable girl I know.
lines.zh: : 就算变成这样，你也还是我认识的最可爱的女孩。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because I’ll steal your organs if you don’t.
lines.zh: : 你这么说，只是因为你不说我就偷走你的器官。

lines.en: : Obviously. I have to stay on your good side, don’t I? And what better way to do that than by peppering you with compliments until you can’t bring yourself to hate me?
lines.zh: : 那当然。我得一直待在你好的那一边，不是吗？还有什么比用夸奖把你淹没、直到你狠不下心来恨我更好的办法呢？

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom25
: I’ll never hate you, Maya. Not even at my worst.
lines.zh: : 我永远不会恨你，Maya。就算在我最糟糕的时候也不会。

lines.en: : If this isn’t your worst, I’m kind of worried about what is.
lines.zh: : 如果这还不算你最糟的样子，我倒是有点担心什么才算。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom26
: I’ll never understand you either, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我也永远搞不懂你。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean I don’t get why you feel the need to hide everything from me. You trust me, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我不明白你为什么非要把一切都瞒着我。你信任我的，对吧？

lines.en: : More than anyone.
lines.zh: : 比任何人都要信任。

lines.en: : Just saying “more than anyone” doesn’t confirm you actually trust me, though. For all I know, you’re just closer to trusting me than anyone else. And that doesn’t mean much, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 可光说「比任何人」并不能证明你真的信任我。就我所知，你也许只是比信任别人更接近信任我而已。遗憾的是，这意义不大。

lines.en: : Well...how can I prove that I trust you?
lines.zh: : 那……我要怎么证明我信任你？

lines.en: : Tell me a secret.
lines.zh: : 告诉我一个秘密。

lines.en: : What kind of secret?
lines.zh: : 什么样的秘密？

lines.en: : Like...who do you have a crush on?
lines.zh: : 比如……你暗恋谁？

lines.en: : Nobody. No one is worthy of me.
lines.zh: : 没有人。没人配得上我。

lines.en: : You’re lying again. You don’t trust me at all.
lines.zh: : 你又说谎了。你根本不信任我。

lines.en: : If you want to play that game, how am I supposed to know you trust me?
lines.zh: : 你要玩这套的话，那我又该怎么知道你信任我？

lines.en: : The same way. I’ll tell you a secret.
lines.zh: : 同样的方式。我告诉你一个秘密。

lines.en: : What kind of secret?
lines.zh: : 什么样的秘密？

lines.en: : That depends on what you want to know.
lines.zh: : 那取决于你想知道什么。

lines.en: : Well, I’m already well aware of who you have a crush on, so...why not tell me what you really think of me?
lines.zh: : 好吧，你暗恋谁我早就一清二楚了，那么……不如告诉我，你到底是怎么看我的？

lines.en: : What I really think?
lines.zh: : 我真正的想法？

lines.en: : Yeah. You’ve been insinuating all sorts of stuff today and I feel like now’s as good a time as any to get anything you might want to say off your chest.
lines.zh: : 嗯。今天你一直在旁敲侧击地说各种话，我觉得现在正是一吐为快的好时机。

lines.en: : Are you sure that’s what you want to know?
lines.zh: : 你确定你想知道的是这个？

lines.en: : Positive.
lines.zh: : 非常确定。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : I think you like masks a little too much.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你太喜欢面具了。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom27
: Masks? Like...my collection?
lines.zh: : 面具？你是说……我的收藏？

lines.en: : Your everything.
lines.zh: : 你的一切。

lines.en: : In fact, I don’t think there’s been a single moment throughout our entire relationship where you haven’t been wearing one.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我觉得在我们整个关系里，没有哪一刻你是没戴着面具的。

lines.en: : And that sucks, since I feel like you’d still be really cute without them.
lines.zh: : 这挺糟糕的，因为我觉得你不戴面具也一样很可爱。

lines.en: : What are you saying?...
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？……

lines.en: : That you’re a liar.
lines.zh: : 我说你是个骗子。

lines.en: : That you’re hiding things from me because there’s something else you’d choose over me if you were ever forced to. And that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 我说你瞒着我，是因为如果被迫选择，你会选别的东西而不是我。不过这没关系。

lines.en: : There’s someone I’d choose over you as well. But at least I’m honest about it.
lines.zh: : 也有人是我会选、而不是选你的。但至少我对此很诚实。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom28
: There’s no one like that.
lines.zh: : 没有那样的人。

lines.en: : Liar, liar, pants on fire. Sitting on a telephone wire.
lines.zh: : 骗子骗子，裤子着火。坐在电话线上躲。

lines.en: : I mean it. There’s really no one who-
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。真的没有谁——

lines.en: : Then kiss me.
lines.zh: : 那就吻我。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom29
: What?...
: If you’re not already in love with somebody, you shouldn’t have any issue with kissing me. Right?
lines.zh: : 如果你没有已经爱上什么人，那吻我应该也没什么问题吧？对吧？

lines.en: : I...don’t. But you wouldn’t want me to do that.
lines.zh: : 我……没有。可你不会想要我这么做的。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom30
: I don’t mind. I’m extremely vulnerable right now, so anything you do has nothing to do with me. Plus, I’ve already kissed Ayane once before. Might as well kiss you too.
lines.zh: : 我不介意。我现在极度脆弱，所以你做什么都与我无关。再说了，我之前已经吻过 Ayane 一次了。吻你一下也无妨。

lines.en: : When the fuck did you kiss Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你他妈什么时候吻过 Ayane？

lines.en: : Christmas. But you probably don’t remember it since your memories went poof.
lines.zh: : 圣诞节的时候。不过你大概不记得了，因为你的记忆「噗」地一下就没了。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom31
: Ami, seriously. Stop fucking with me.
lines.zh: : Ami，说真的。别他妈耍我了。

lines.en: : I’m not fucking with you. I just know you’re hiding your true feelings from me and that you won’t do anything because you’re so “in love” with that other person. But still, you won’t tell me who it is.
lines.zh: : 我没有耍你。我只是知道你在对我隐瞒真实的感情，而因为你「深爱」着那个人，你什么都不会做。可你还是不肯告诉我那个人是谁。

lines.en: : Because there’s no one like that. Really.
lines.zh: : 因为真的没有那样的人。真的。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Really.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : Really really?
lines.zh: : 真的真的？

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom32
: Really really.
lines.zh: : 真的真的。

lines.en: : So you haven’t been having sex with my uncle behind my back?
lines.zh: : 那你没有背着我跟我舅舅上床？

lines.en: : I would never.
lines.zh: : 我绝不会。

lines.en: : And you didn’t come here today to have sex with him?
lines.zh: : 那你今天来这儿，也不是为了跟他做爱？

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是。

lines.en: : You promise?
lines.zh: : 你保证？

lines.en: : I promise.
lines.zh: : 我保证。

lines.en: : What will you let me do to you if I find out you’re lying?
lines.zh: : 如果我发现你说谎，你随我怎么处置？

lines.en: : Anything you want.
lines.zh: : 随你想怎么样。

lines.en: : Anything?
lines.zh: : 什么都可以？

lines.en: : Anything anything.
lines.zh: : 什么都可以，什么都可以。

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom33
: Hm.
: Okay.
: Okay?
: Yeah. That’s the kind of promise I can get behind. And the exact type of loyalty I want out of a best friend.
lines.zh: : 嗯。这种承诺我认。也正是我想从最好的朋友身上得到的那种忠诚。

lines.en: : Then...you trust me?
lines.zh: : 那么……你信任我了？

lines.en: scene mayaamisadroom34
: More than anyone.
lines.zh: : 比任何人都要信任。

lines.en: scene black
: Sensei’s probably at the shrine.
lines.zh: : Sensei 大概在神社。

lines.en: : What?...
: He’s been having a tough time lately.
lines.zh: : 他最近过得很不好。

lines.en: : He probably went there to pray.
lines.zh: : 他大概是去那儿祈祷了。

lines.en: : Why are you-
lines.zh: : 你为什么——

lines.en: : Mm...Sorry, Maya. I’m feeling really tired all of a sudden. Do you mind if I take a nap?
lines.zh: : 嗯……抱歉，Maya。我突然觉得特别困。介意我睡一会儿吗？

lines.en: : What?...I...uhh...yeah.
: Yeah, that’s...I can go.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那……我可以走了。

lines.en: : Thanks...I really appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 谢谢……真的很感谢你。

lines.en: : Being “insane” is super exhausting. And so loud too.
lines.zh: : 「发疯」真是累死了。而且还特别吵。

lines.en: : Loud?...
: You wouldn’t get it.
lines.zh: : 你不会懂的。

lines.en: : You’ve never hurt someone before.
lines.zh: : 你从来没有伤害过别人。

lines.en: Maya Makinami has gained that status effect [[PARANOID]!
lines.zh: Maya Makinami 获得了状态效果 [[PARANOID]]！

lines.en: You two have so much in common!
lines.zh: 你们俩的共同点可真多！
